Summarize Cross-Validation Scores for Spatial RiskMap Models

Source: R/auxiliary.R
summary.RiskMap_cross_validation.Rd

This function summarizes cross-validation scores for different spatial models obtained from assess_prediction.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'RiskMap_cross_validation'
summary(object, ...)

Arguments

object

A RiskMap_cross_validation object containing cross-validation scores for each model, as obtained from assess_prediction.

...

Not used, and an error if given, so that a misspelt argument is not ignored.

Value

A matrix of summary scores with models as rows and metrics as columns, with class "summary.RiskMap_cross_validation".

Details

The function returns a matrix whose rows are the models and whose columns are the scores, CRPS and SCRPS averaged over all test observations that have a score, and PIT_area with PIT_area_expected, its value under perfect calibration, when calibration was assessed (see assess_prediction()). Lower is better for every score. Attributes of the returned object include:

  • test_set_means: A list of average scores for each test set and model.

  • keep_par_fixed: Whether the parameters were fixed at the estimates from all the data.

  • n_failed: The number of failed test-set assessments.

Its print gives the averages and the scores of each test set.

See also

assess_prediction
